current.creator: The Clash
current.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go
current.quote:
This indecision’s bugging me (Esta indecisión me molesta)
If you don’t want me, set me free (Si no me quieres, líbrame)
Exactly whom I’m supposed to be (Dígame qué tengo ser)
Don’t you know which clothes even fit me? (¿Sabes qué ropa me queda?)
Come on and let me know (Ahora me tienes que decir)
Should I cool it, or should I blow? (¿Me debo ir o quedarme?)
current.reference: The Clash, “Should I Stay or Should I Go,” 1982.
current.comment: Here The Clash tells many things: How complex things are? What do we desire from the future? And wish to know if current decisions have real consequences - and decisions pull apart.
